meta.title: About us
meta.description: Aura Academy was founded by Amira Bechini, CEO of Amira Beauty Suite: over 8 years in the beauty industry and more than 150 students trained. Professional training in permanent makeup and lash and brow lamination throughout Italy.

about.titleA: We teach from inside the profession,
about.lede: Founded by Amira Bechini: CEO of Amira Beauty Suite, permanent makeup artist, more than eight years in the industry. Every technique taught here is one she performs on real clients.
about.portrait: Amira Bechini in her beauty institute

story.title: From the treatment room to the classroom
story.role: Founder of Aura Academy · CEO of Amira Beauty Suite
story.imageAlt: Amira Bechini at work during a course
story.p1: I run Amira Beauty Suite, an institute specialised in advanced aesthetic treatments, and founded Aura Academy to teach what I practise: permanent makeup and lash and brow lamination.
story.p2: In more than eight years I have trained over 150 students and built a method of my own: technical excellence, hands-on practice, entrepreneurial vision. It began simply, to help people feel confident, and to give women a real profession.
story.p3: I have never stopped studying: international masterclasses, the latest PMU techniques. My own institute taught me the rest, not just the technique, but what clients and the market need.
story.p4: Aura Academy is the school I wanted when I started: personalised guidance, practical education, continuous support, and a career that lasts. Today we train across Italy.

different.title: Built on the work, not on the theory
different.sub: Three deliberate choices sit behind every course we run.

experience.title: Real industry experience
experience.body: Aura Academy grew out of daily practice inside a working institute. What you learn here has already been tested on real clients.

small.title: Small classes, by design
small.body: Places are intentionally limited. A small group is what makes individual attention possible, rather than something we promise and cannot give.

support.title: Before, during and after
support.body: Continuous mentoring, practical feedback, correction of your work, and professional guidance once the course has ended.

beyond.title: A technique alone is not a career.
beyond.sub: A PMU artist has to master more than the treatment. Alongside the technique, we teach the eight things that turn a skill into a business.

mission.quote: The certificate is not the point. The career is.
mission.body: We don't simply teach treatments. We educate professionals, combining technical excellence, practical experience, entrepreneurial mindset and continuous support, so every student leaves genuinely prepared.

vision.title: An international reference for PMU education
vision.body: An international reference for professional education in permanent makeup and lamination, built through a network of certified trainers and a community that holds the same standards.
vision.closing: Modern, practical, market-oriented education, and more women able to build an independent future.

blurbs.microblading: Hair by hair strokes drawn with a manual blade, following the natural growth of the brow.
blurbs.powder-brows: A soft shaded brow built with the machine, from a light veil to a defined finish.
blurbs.lip-blush: Colour worked into the lip to correct the tone and redefine the border.
blurbs.eyeliner-pmu: A line set at the base of the lashes, from a discreet enhancement to a defined eye.
blurbs.lash-lamination: A lifting treatment that opens the eye by reshaping the natural lash.
blurbs.brow-lamination: The brow hair restructured and set in the direction that suits the face.

faq.title: Before you begin.
faq.more: Can't find your answer? Write to us and we'll reply.

courses.a: Microblading, Powder Brows, Lip Blush, PMU Eyeliner, Lash Lamination and Brow Lamination, at base and advanced level.

duration.a: Duration varies by the course chosen. We confirm it along with your quote.

price.q: How much does a course cost?
price.a: Every course is quoted individually and shared privately rather than published. Write to us and you'll receive the full information, including the kit option.

includes.a: Theory, hands-on practice, a live model where scheduled, and post-course support.

kit.a: The kit is available on request. Where it is included, the course price reflects it.

students.q: How many students are on a course?
students.a: Three to four. Places are limited by design.

certificate.a: Yes, at the end of the course.

language.q: What language are the courses taught in?

booking.q: How do I book and how do I pay?
booking.a: Book on WhatsApp or the contact form. Your place is confirmed with a deposit, agreed between us; payment by bank transfer, card or PagoDIL.

location.a: Across Italy. Write to us and we will send you the details for the course you have in mind.

beginners.q: Is the course suitable for beginners?
beginners.a: Yes. Every technique is taught at base level, from the beginning, and at advanced level for those already working.
